selection_method: passed-task coverage weighted 70 percent and task coverage weighted 30 percent, latency as tie-breaker

builder.limitation: small Golden Task suite; tie resolved by measured latency

reviewer.limitation: visual-critique task is text-only and does not prove multimodal visual review

researcher.limitation: source retrieval and contradiction handling were not live-tested in this matrix

visual-critic.limitation: no image payload was used; this is language critique evidence only

architect.limitation: architecture-specific rubric and long-context stress test remain open

fast.limitation: fast selection optimizes measured latency only after pass requirement

not_claimed: No model is certified as universally best.
No multimodal visual model ranking is claimed from text-only tasks.
The degraded gcli/grok-4.6 records remain evidence of 429 failure, not a quality judgment.
